# Generated by scripts/gen-cli-docs.sh from 'lazysubmodules foreach -h'; do not edit.

Usage: lazysubmodules foreach -- <command> [args...]

Run a command, without a shell, in every managed submodule that is checked
out, in .gitmodules order. Uninitialized submodules are skipped with a note.
The first command that fails ends foreach with exit status 1. The command
gets the variables name, sm_path, displaypath, sha1, toplevel, LSM_MODE and
LSM_REF. The '--' may be left out when the command does not start with '-'.
